item.title: Iran, Russia finalizing small reactors construction protocol: AEOI
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI) has announced that cooperation with Russia to build small modular reactors is underway, and a protocol with Moscow will be signed to accelerate the construction process.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86306261/Iran-Russia-finalizing-small-reactors-construction-protocol

Tehran, IRNA – The spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI) has announced that cooperation with Russia to build small modular reactors is underway, and a protocol with Moscow will be signed to accelerate the construction process.

item.title: Iran embassy in Kuwait rejects allegation linking Iranian national to assassination plot
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Iran’s embassy in Kuwait has firmly denied allegations that an Iranian national was involved in a plot to assassinate public figures or threaten Kuwait’s national security, saying the individual had not been in the country for the past 10 years.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86306018/Iran-embassy-in-Kuwait-rejects-allegation-linking-Iranian-national

item.title: Iran says ready to help draft global treaty on plastic pollution
